# Recline

> Recline is an independent, self-funded online community platform in open beta. It offers configurable Spaces, text and direct messaging, and voice/video calls. Basic chat signup does not require an email address or phone number, and core communication features are free.

Recline's public website is https://recline.social/ and its web app is at https://app.recline.social/. For current beta availability, limitations, and data handling, consult the Beta Status and Privacy & Trust pages rather than treating roadmap ideas as shipped features. Client-side encryption applies to supported message text; attachments and routing metadata have different privacy boundaries. The project has not yet completed an independent security audit.

## Official product information

- [Recline homepage](https://recline.social/): Product overview and entry points.
- [About Recline](https://recline.social/about/): Project background, mission, and operating model.
- [Current beta status](https://recline.social/beta-status/): Feature availability, limitations, and safeguards under review.
- [Privacy and trust](https://recline.social/privacy): Data handling, message-text encryption boundaries, and known limitations.
- [Public roadmap](https://recline.social/roadmap/): Current priorities, work in progress, and exploratory ideas.
- [Use Recline in the browser](https://app.recline.social/): Web application and account signup.
- [Windows desktop availability](https://recline.social/download/): Current desktop release and download status.

## Guides and technical information

- [How Recline encrypts messages](https://recline.social/blog/how-recline-encrypts/): Channel and direct-message text encryption explained.
- [Inside Recline's open-source chat client](https://recline.social/blog/inside-reclines-open-source-chat-client/): Client architecture, realtime messaging, calls, and desktop packaging.
- [How voice calls work](https://recline.social/blog/how-voice-calls-work/): WebRTC, STUN, TURN, and connection limitations.
- [How to move a Discord community](https://recline.social/blog/how-to-move-a-discord-server/): Practical community migration guidance.
- [Recline blog](https://recline.social/blog/): News, tutorials, comparisons, and technical explainers.
